summary: AI Review (GPT-4o) statement engine tested end-to-end. Backend 9/9 pytest pass: live upload of mercury_2024-10-06.pdf (engine=ai_review, liability) -> 200 processing/ai_review; ai_stage progressed summary->transactions->posting->done; status completed, 166 txns, Mercury account, period 2024-09-07..2024-10-06; detail has 166 txns summing 79.91 (155 neg / 11 pos), reconciliation.ties=true, ai_rows=166, no ai_doc key, references present (00020009), source ai_review. Export.xlsx sheets [Summary, All Transactions, Withdrawals, Deposits] with 167/156/12 rows. Needs-review gate on Mongo clones: approve completed->400, approve held->200 completed 166, re-approve->400 'not waiting for review', reject->200 rejected with 0 txns, re-reject->400. engine=veryfi routes to Veryfi (method veryfi, completed). Frontend: heldtest-ui row (needs review pill, AI Review method, red Review btn) -> detail page shows ai-review-panel with all expected summary values, 'off by $42.50', 'Totals don't tie', Approve/Reject buttons, 166 extracted rows; Export Excel triggers download mercury_held_demo_transactions.xlsx. Pre-upload modal engine switch works, highlights AI Review, persists in localStorage across modal reopen, FormData sends engine=ai_review + account_kind_hint=liability, row shows 'AI Review in progress…'; completion toast '166 txns posted (AI Review, totals tie ✓)' and completed row verified, delete via trash + confirm works. NOTE: the frontend upload's completion was verified with a mocked upload response + Mongo-flipped status (not a 3rd live GPT call) because the 2-run GPT budget got used by the backend suite (pytest-xdist ran the upload fixture in 2 workers -> 2 live uploads, both produced identical 166-txn results).

minor.issue: transaction_count is set to len(doc['transactions']) which is always [] (rows live under accounts[].transactions), so a genuinely held needs_review import shows 0 transactions in the imports list and in the toast/upload row. The seeded heldtest-ui only shows 166 because it was seeded that way. Use len(review['rows']) or sum of accounts[].transactions.

Check-then-post is not atomic: two concurrent approves (double click / two tabs) both pass the status=='needs_review' check and post twice. Use find_one_and_update({id, status:'needs_review'}, {$set:{status:'processing'}}) as a claim.
If posting fails the row goes to 'failed' and can never be re-approved (approve requires needs_review). Consider allowing retry from failed when ai_doc exists.

asyncio.create_task result not retained — background task can be garbage-collected mid-run; keep a reference in a module-level set. Also a backend restart mid-extraction leaves the row stuck in 'processing' forever.

issues: Header says '0 transactions' while the imports list says 166 and the panel lists 166 extracted rows — label as '0 posted · 166 extracted' to avoid confusion
Subtitle still says 'let Veryfi OCR pull the transactions' — doesn't mention the AI Review option
Bank / Cash card keeps an indigo highlighted border even when Credit Card / Loan radio is selected — ambiguous which is chosen
In _startSplitPoll a needs_review AI import maps the upload entry to status 'completed' (green txns chip) even though nothing posted
